subject: reasoning
question:
C $ D' means 'C is the brother of D'

'C #D' means 'C is the sister of D'

'C + D' means 'C is the father of D'

'C - D' means 'C is the mother of D'

If 'P $ Z+Q $ B', then how is P related to B?

options.text: P is the brother of B
P is the father of B
P is the father-in-law of B
P is the paternal uncle of B

solution:

**Given expression:** 'P $ Z+Q $ B'

P is the brother of Z, Z is the father of Q and Q is the brother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bb72e0a40100effb88cb7b26b58c7b579ae44ec57b305bbd83d212432f28630.png] 

Here, P is the paternal uncle of B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
